analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($366.11) vs SMA5 ($380.50)/SMA20 ($414.55)/SMA50 ($416.44): below, indicating short-to-medium term weak positioning.
· Below SMA100 ($414.11)/SMA200 ($394.22): confirming medium-to-long term trend weakness.
· 52-week position (32.6%) + current price above 52-week low ($311.92), below 52-week high ($478.00).
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 34.9→30.8 (entering oversold): continued weakness, exploring potential for a bounce.
· MACD histogram -4.8702→-6.5799 (worsening): strengthening downtrend, maintaining dead cross.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $367.20): approaching lower band, entering oversold territory.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($364.36): above 5-day low ($358.51), above Pivot S1 ($332.41).
· Swing resistance ($368.29): below 5-day high ($400.00), potential for short-term bounce if broken.
· 5-day/20-day price pattern (Not Higher Low, Not Lower High): entering sideways range, lack of directional momentum.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.74x): subdued volume, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to RSI entering oversold and MACD continuing to weaken; confirmation of $364.36 support level needed.
